next_step.title: Mt. San Antonio's maps, then the refused colleges' own pages
next_step.text: Read Mt. San Antonio's Early Childhood Education map and file its sequence record, then look on each refused college's own pages and catalog for a map outside the mapper. The addenda follow Sunday's census apply.

calls.title: Check two new records?
calls.text: Irvine Valley Art A.A. 10265 and Santa Monica Barbering A.S. 43767, each laid out on its card. Sierra quotes neither program's requirements until Sam checks it.
calls.if_no_reply: both stay unchecked, and the queue moves on to the maps.

view.text: See both records on CPL Pathways

calls.title: Paste one library update?
calls.text: The update that makes the latest open-asks sheet current on the Library tab timed out four times through the sessions' tool. The SQL is on the card, for the Supabase SQL editor.
calls.if_no_reply: the Library tab keeps listing sheet 48 as current.

calls.title: Accept Mt. San Antonio's Fire Technology map?
calls.text: It places the certificate's courses in five terms and recommends three KINF preparation courses the certificate does not list, so the parser holds it.
calls.if_no_reply: the map stays filed and places no course.

calls.title: Count a refused map as settled?
calls.text: 24 of 32 published maps sit on Program Mapper hosts that refuse the reader, so the Read program maps milestone cannot finish while it counts only maps read.
